housing: Philadelphia's rentals are mostly brick row houses, either whole or split into apartments, plus older twins and apartment buildings.

localRules.text: Philadelphia landlords who need a rental license must give each tenant a signed Certificate of Rental Suitability and the city's Partners for Good Housing handbook at the start of the tenancy.

tenantHelp.name: City of Philadelphia: free legal help to avoid eviction

climate: Test the heat and look for leaks and damp in basements and around old windows; winters are cold and row houses are often old.
fact: A Philadelphia landlord can only issue a Certificate of Rental Suitability with an active rental license and no open code violations.
